svg.text: EVERY GAME USES THE SAME HARDWARE
the game, the countdown, what you hold
asset · seconds left in the window · your balance
the main action — PLAY, TAKE, PRESS, CASH OUT
the label always says which · Enter or Space
the payout you are asking for — drag it
always navigate, whatever the game is doing
YOU ARE HOLDING A DEVICE, NOT FILLING IN A FORM. ESC OPENS THE MENU FROM ANYWHERE.
